_comment: Immutable pin for the build-time hydration of assets/db/interaction_db.sqlite. The sha256 is the integrity authority (a release asset can be replaced under the same tag). Consumed by tool/fetch_interaction_db.sh, the CI hydrate step, and the packaging-guard test — the ONE source of these values. clinical_content_hash is a provenance cross-ref to the med-nutrient artifact (a SEPARATE identity from the SQLite sha256); the med-nutrient parity pin lives in test/services/stack/med_nutrient_bundled_parity_test.dart.
